github.description: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: a data marketplace connecting enterprise, financial, legal, patent and research data. Manage authorization, search tools and troubleshoot MCP connections. Supports OAuth, API keys and HTTP/stdio.

readme.heroZh: > DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 数据市场：汇聚各类垂直领域数据厂商与开放数据源，通过超百个 MCP连接器接入 MCP Server，统一授权、查找工具与连接排障。
readme.heroEn: > MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: a data marketplace connecting specialist providers and open data sources. Browse 100+ connectors, manage authorization, search tools and troubleshoot MCP connections.
readme.ctaZh: 如果它帮你更快地接入 MCP Server，欢迎 [GitHub 点个 Star](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/stargazers)、[提交新的连接器](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md)或[参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)。
readme.ctaEn: If the plugin helps you connect an MCP server faster, consider [starring the repository](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector/stargazers), [submitting a connector](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md), or [contributing a fix](CONTRIBUTING.md).

externalListing.en: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: a specialist MCP marketplace and manager panel for Model Context Protocol data sources. Connect enterprise, financial, legal, patent, research and geospatial data; manage authorization, search tools and troubleshoot connections. Supports OAuth, API keys and HTTP/stdio. Provider permissions and fees apply.
externalListing.zh: MCP连接器：DeepSeek Harness 的专业 MCP 市场、数据市场与 MCP 管理面板，汇聚企业、金融、法律、专利、科研和地理等 Model Context Protocol（MCP）数据源。通过超百个 MCP连接器接入 MCP Server，支持连接管理、授权配置、跨连接搜索工具与排障；支持 OAuth、API Key、HTTP/stdio。由企查查/QCC团队维护；数据权限与费用以各服务商为准。
